channel.title: Canada Flight Schedules - Canadian Aviation News & Flight Operations
channel.description: Daily updated Canadian civil aviation schedules, operational safety briefings, aerodrome procedures, and airline fleet telemetry.

item.title: The Anatomy of Winter Flight Operations in Canada: De-Icing Holdover Times, Runway Friction, and Transport Canada Directives
item.description: An exhaustive 1,000-word operational analysis of cold-weather airline dispatch across Canadian aerodromes, detailing Type I and Type IV glycol chemistry, Canadian Runway Friction Index (CRFI) deceleration metrics, and NAV CANADA slot management during major blizzard events.
item.author: anissagustiawati@gmail.com (Capt. Robert McAllister, FRAeS)

item.title: NAV CANADA and the Space-Based ADS-B Revolution: How Satellite Surveillance Transformed Canadian Flight Routes
item.description: An authoritative 1,000-word investigative report detailing how Ottawa-based NAV CANADA co-founded the Aireon space-based ADS-B constellation, eliminating radar blind spots across the High Arctic, North Atlantic, and Canadian domestic trunk routes.
item.author: anissagustiawati@gmail.com (Dr. Jean-Marc Tremblay, P.Eng.)

item.title: Naviguer dans les grands aéroports canadiens : Guide logistique des correspondances à Toronto-Pearson (YYZ), Montréal-Trudeau (YUL) et Vancouver (YVR)
item.description: Un guide opérationnel exhaustif de plus de 1 000 mots décrivant les procédures aéroportuaires canadiennes, les temps minimaux de correspondance (MCT), les contrôles de sécurité de l’ACSTA, les bornes de l’ASFC et le pré-dédouanement américain (CBP).
item.author: anissagustiawati@gmail.com (Mélanie Bouchard, Adm.A.)

item.title: The Arctic Lifeline: How Gravel Kits, Combi Jets, and Sub-Zero Logistics Keep Canada's North Connected
item.description: A comprehensive 1,000-word field examination of commercial aviation in Nunavut, the Northwest Territories, and the Yukon, exploring how airlines like Canadian North and Air Tindi battle -50°C weather, permafrost runway heave, and isolated medevac emergencies.
item.author: anissagustiawati@gmail.com (Capt. Alistair MacIntyre)

item.title: Inside the Cockpit Over the Canadian Rockies: A Chief Pilot and Flight Dispatcher on Mountain Waves, RNAV-RNP, and Cold-Temperature Corrections
item.description: An exclusive 1,100-word transcribed technical dialogue and roundtable interview between an Air Canada Airbus A220 line captain and a WestJet flight dispatch coordinator, detailing mountain wave rotor turbulence, RNP-AR curved approaches into Kelowna, and critical barometric altitude temperature compensation in Canadian winter airspace.
item.author: anissagustiawati@gmail.com (Editorial Desk (Moderated by Capt. Robert McAllister))

item.title: The Great Canadian Transcontinental Airline War: How Porter’s Embraer E195-E2 Fleet Is Challenging the Air Canada & WestJet Duopoly
item.description: An exhaustive 1,150-word economic, aerodynamic, and market analysis examining how Toronto-based Porter Airlines transitioned from regional turboprops into a nationwide transcontinental carrier, deploying Pratt & Whitney GTF engines, no-middle-seat 2x2 cabin layouts, and high-frequency hub routes across Canada.
item.author: anissagustiawati@gmail.com (Mélanie Bouchard, Adm.A.)
